title: Качество данных
semantics: Profile every input field using the observed Loginom 7.4.2 native Quality defaults. Integer/real continuous fields and discrete strings only in this proposal. Read ALL five outputs from one execution: 0 OutData, 1 OutDataOut, 2 OutDataExtr, 3 OutDataNull, 4 SummaryTable. In the observed default configuration, 0 and 3 preserve the entire input and 1/2 are empty even when summary Out/Extr counts are positive. Port captions do not define row filters. Summary has one row per input field in source order: N is its one-based ordinal, DisplayName is its label, DataType/DataKind are native labels, Null/Out/Extr are per-field counts, Avg excludes NULL, Median is the upper middle observation, and Moda is histogram-based for continuous numbers and frequency-based for discrete strings. Empty string is a value. Numeric Moda and string Moda share a variant column. Never claim exact variant values from ordinary formatted Table text. No dedicated algorithm wizard exists; five output mapping pages and Done are observed. Native Train is available; the same-data Train/Execute trial did not change the first output. Saved-model apply is not an admitted mode. No data correction or row removal is promised by profile.

parameter_schema.description: Must be {} in profile mode. The native node has no dedicated parameter page. Hidden MaxNullsPercent and per-field correction actions are not writable parameters in this proposal. Use ordinary input/output mappings only within the approved default scope; unsupported types or non-default configurations must refuse before mutation. Existing parameters:{} preserves native settings. No numeric magic enums, thresholds, model or imputation options are accepted.

limitations: Proposal only: no runtime handler is installed by this documentation.
All five ports and the variant mode metric must pass independent acceptance before availability is advertised.
General reader recognition for the five Quality mapping pages is approved for stage 1; binning behavior must remain unchanged.
Port admission and exact variant read limitations are recorded separately in discovery.md.
